verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in AI palette. You highlight text and press cmd+j to run about a dozen prompts (e.g. 'list action-items', 'list key takeaways'), ask free-form requests, save custom prompts, chat with filtered notes, and choose GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. However, the evidence shows only text transformation and Q&A on selected or filtered content, not an assistant that carries out delegated multi-step tasks or acts on the workspace. Missing for 10: agentic task execution (creating, editing or organizing notes, or triggering integrations on the user's behalf), multi-step delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
